items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Tip-A-Lite sang with the group sometimes.

ctx.x: Yeah. Sam Noel. L-E-L? Noel. Yeah. Sam Noel. Uh, let's see. Man, I'd go back. We were little kids in that parallel and I played with Fess. Uh, uh, Batman, Leroy Reagan. That's right. Uh, gee. Well. Mine gets kind of blanked back that way. Uh, there was, a long hair, no hair, and short hair. Right. Uh, Jesse Hill sang with the group sometimes. Yeah. Yeah. Uh, Tip-A-Lite sang with the group sometimes. Uh, his name was, uh, we called him Tip-A-Lite.
